title: Lower bound for the amplification parameter
statement: For all natural numbers $F,n,d$, if $d+5\le F$, then $32(n+1)^d\le 2^{F\ell(n)}$, where $\ell(n)$ is one more than the length of the binary representation of $n$.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers F, n, and d
